successors.name: British Cape Colony
successors.text: 'territories to the south of the Molopo and Nossob rivers (excluding Griqualand West)'; 'had an area of 51,424 square miles (133,190 km2)'

ledger.x: 30 September 1885: Stellaland, Goshen and the Tswana lands south of the Molopo become the Crown colony of British Bechuanaland.
16 November 1895: British Bechuanaland is annexed to the Cape Colony.
16 November 1895: the colony ends in the Cape Colony.

certainty.note: Colony bounded by the Molopo and Nossob rivers on the north; the Griqualand West boundary on the south.
